data.name: Daaem
data.long_meaning: The name Daaem is derived from the Arabic root word 'd-m-m', which means 'firm, steadfast, constant, and persistent'. In Islamic context, it can be interpreted as one who is steadfast in faith, unwavering in belief, and committed to righteousness.
